summary: AI finance team for freelancers: finds money leaks in Zetaris data, explains why with evidence, simulates what-ifs, and ranks moves the user approves or rejects.

data.access: Agents read data only through Zetaris views via POST /sql-editor/sqls/run (SELECT only)

power.ai_provider: Meterless Nightshift (Meterless Runtime 1.4, provider contract v4)

used_by: World Model / H-MEM engine generate calls

meterless_engines.role: Shared state for agents: clients, vendors, invoices and findings ingested from Zetaris views; getContext(entityId) for agents
meterless_engines.used_by: orchestrator: ingests full Zetaris view rows + findings after Leak Hunter (backend/src/zetaris/entitySql.ts); powers GET /api/entities/:id (Client & Subscription 360)

meterless_engines.role: Remembers each approve/reject decision; top memories are retrieved at run start and change the CFO ranking
meterless_engines.used_by: CFO: applyMemoriesToMoves changes ranking and adds memory_note; orchestrator.decide records each approve/reject; disk persistence across restarts; powers GET & DELETE /api/memories

meterless_engines.role: Runs the Explainer investigation in bounded chunks, one hypothesis per chunk, carrying evidence forward
meterless_engines.used_by: Explainer: bounded multi-chunk investigation, answer grounded against finding evidence

findings.result: 6/6 found, 0 false alarms (live run, Zetaris + Nemotron)

stability.result: 5/5 live runs (Nemotron via Nightshift, mock Zetaris views), 26 Oct 2026: 6/6 found and 0 false alarms each time, same 3 action types, 0 llm_failed, 129-197 s per run

run.sample_mode: ZETARIS_MOCK=1 (default in Docker); agents fall back to deterministic answers without Nightshift

pre_existing.component: Meterless engine reference implementations (World Model, H-MEM, Markovian Thinking)
pre_existing.built_during_hackathon: the adapters (backend/src/engines/*Adapter.ts) and their integration into the agents
